# JAECOO Indonesia Jakarta Selatan

> Official Dealer Website for JAECOO Premium SUVs in South Jakarta (Jakarta Selatan). Located at JAECOO City Store, Lotte Mall Kuningan. Provides comprehensive information on the JAECOO vehicle lineup, tech profiles, promo offers, dealership details, and direct contact options for test drives.

## Core Models
- [JAECOO J5 EV](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/J5EV.html): Features, distance specs (500+ km range), and design details of the Premium Electric SUV. Available at dealer JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.
- [JAECOO J7](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/j7.html): Details of the Urban Premium SUV available in SHS (Super Hybrid System) and AWD (All-Wheel Drive). Test drive at JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.
- [JAECOO J8](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/j8.html): Specs, luxury interior details, and performance of the Premium Flagship SUV. Available at dealer JAECOO Jakarta Selatan.

## Technology & Engineering
- [SHS & ARDIS Technology](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/shs-ardis.html): Tech details on Chery's Super Hybrid System (SHS) and All Road Drive Intelligent System (ARDIS) for advanced off-roading.

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://omodajaecoojaksel.id/faq.html): Frequently asked questions on ordering, test drives, financing, and JAECOO features at Jakarta Selatan showroom.
